# Committed Roadmap

## Purpose

Builds the roadmap.

## Workflow

1. Place items into the Now (committed) horizon first.
2. Present the committed v1 scope for sign-off.

## Output Format

A roadmap grouping the agreed work into horizons for stakeholder review.
